summary: Penalty weight for crossing zone boundaries.
businessRules: penalty_factor defines: Specify a non-negative value which indicates the penalty of crossing zones on the same route. Default penalty value is 0. A higher value, for example 30.0, will place a higher penalty on zone viola…
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Zero means no penalty/cost; larger values increase incentive to avoid violation.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: higher penalty_factor keeps routes inside their zone.
